name: Mask City: Chapter Zero
source:
Middleton’s favorite superhero is no stranger to fighting crime. He’s been protecting his town for years against a variety of villains, both the enhanced kind and the normies.

But when his beautiful nemesis robs the wrong jewelry store, everything changes. There’s a killer on the loose, and this small-town superhero has to team up with a bunch of interesting allies…the photographer with a secret, the detective with a chip on her shoulder, and an old high school crush who now sees him in a new light.

But his most powerful partner just might be the beautiful but ruthless burglar he’s been pursuing for years.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3870370/Mask_City_Chapter_Zero/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
米德尔顿最喜欢的超级英雄对打击犯罪并不陌生。多年来，他一直在保护自己的城镇免受各种恶棍的侵害，包括增强型恶棍和普通恶棍。

但当他美丽的对手抢劫了错误的珠宝店时，一切都改变了。有一名杀手逍遥法外，这位小镇超级英雄必须与一群有趣的盟友联手……有秘密的摄影师、心怀不满的侦探，以及现在对他刮目相看的高中旧情人。

但他最强大的伙伴可能是他多年来一直追捕的美丽但无情的窃贼。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3870370/Mask_City_Chapter_Zero/]Steam[/url]]
